title: AWS Batch and Amazon Lightsail

kcs.statement: AWS Batch runs large numbers of batch jobs, packaged as container images, on managed EC2 (including Spot) or Fargate capacity. Unlike Lambda, it has no 15-minute limit.
Amazon Lightsail bundles virtual servers, storage, databases and networking at a low, predictable monthly price for simple websites and for users with little cloud experience.

problem_ideas: A genomics lab queues 10,000 analysis jobs of 3 hours each: which service schedules them?
A freelancer wants a WordPress site for a fixed monthly price without learning EC2 and VPC: which service?
Compare Batch and Lambda on maximum run time, packaging and how they are triggered.
A distractor offers Lightsail for a global, auto-scaling microservices platform: why is it a poor fit?
A nightly 6-hour risk calculation could tolerate interruption: what capacity could AWS Batch use to cut cost?
Sort four requirements into Lambda, Batch or Lightsail.
